title: Fixed-budget groundwater information-carrier screening
scope: Mechanistic screening only. P5B does not establish dynamic state sufficiency, application acceptance, or a new closure.

characterization_workload.note: Histories are response-exposed from P4 and therefore may only support carrier screening, not blind validation or sufficiency claims.

BASE16.gradient_estimator: retention-inverted pressure-head difference between cell centers divided by 2.5 cm

SPLIT17.gradient_estimator: retention-inverted pressure-head difference between half-cell centers divided by 1.25 cm

flux_reconstruction.target: Reference native BOTTOM_FLUX at observation windows
flux_reconstruction.sign_authority: Existing Reference harness uses qeq=-K for gravity-equilibrium fixed bottom flux; preserve native bottom-outward sign.

metrics: mean absolute per-history signed bottom-flux bias cm/day

decision_policy.componentwise_noninferior: Candidate metric <= BASE16 for all three metrics separately for each material.
decision_policy.strict_gain: At least one metric strictly lower for each material.
decision_policy.HYDRAULIC_SHAPE_SIGNAL: HM17 componentwise noninferior to BASE16 with strict gain for B01 and B14.
decision_policy.STORAGE_SPLIT_SIGNAL: SPLIT17 componentwise noninferior to BASE16 with strict gain for B01 and B14.
decision_policy.BOTH_SIGNAL: Both candidate types satisfy their signal rule.
decision_policy.MIXED_SIGNAL: Material-specific or metric-specific gains without the preregistered cross-material componentwise rule.
